ModMetaData.name: Local Tweaks (sammael)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Personal XML tweaks. - Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients: decorative pneumatic tubes in vaults can be deconstructed. The launch port and termini are left alone (they have code behind them). - Cyanobot's Plant Gen Patches + Biomes! Oasis: drops RG_Plant_JoshuaTree / RG_Plant_WingCactus from biome wildPlants while ReGrowth 2 keeps those defs commented out. - Consistent Text: restores the Alpha Animals refinery recipe label (AA_ExtractUranium) that its patch deletes. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: removes the hand tracks and the body-lowering root.z track from the children's Floordrawing animation (Flourish_Kid_FloorDraw) so Show Me Your Tools' crayon and hands are the only hands drawn and line up with the body. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: mirrors the telescope pose (Flourish_Watch_Telescope) so the pawn stands on the eyepiece side, facing East. - Show Me Your Tools: no handheld spyglass while using a telescope (UseTelescope removed from JE_Tool_Spyglass); it stays for skygazing. - Hauler's Dream: batch crafting (HaulersDream_BatchCraft) uses the same Flourish Everyday animations and Show Me Your Tools tools as a normal bill (DoBill).
